verdict.rationale: Ramp's own product pages say its in-product AI agents scan transactions in real time for anomalies and flag risky or unclear items for human review. They also say the agents flag fraud and enforce policy, which covers both the anomalous and the out-of-policy parts of the story. The evidence is marketing-level only, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how policy-violation detection is configured and how the review queue works, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the flagging works as claimed.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
